technical.summary: Mixed technical setup with short-term momentum (RSI14 rising, SAR/Supertrend bullish) conflicting with intermediate trend weakness (price below key moving averages, Ichimoku below cloud); moderate confluence but elevated overbought conditions and weak ADX limit conviction.

fundamental.summary: No actionable smart money signals detected; insider/institutional activity absent, government contracts and lobbying data unavailable, earnings in 59 days presents elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (20/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; weak congressional buying from junior members offers minimal conviction support; no recent news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (343.2), rising dollar, and recent CPI event creates hostile environment for equities; 59-day earnings window provides some buffer but offers no mitigation to current systemic stress.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI14 rising, SAR/Supertrend bullish, OBV rising) with extreme fear sentiment (20/100) creates contrarian buy opportunity near support at 60.41.
